title: repo-wiki pages (herd-helper-cli.md and others) still document the deleted tk herd commands
body: Same problem as tick gms, one layer over: repo-wiki/herd-helper-cli.md documents internal/herd/spawn, wait, collect, cleanup, reconcile in detail as if tk herd still drives them. gms only fixed skills/ticks (the tick's stated scope); the repo-wiki has its own staleness-detection mechanism and may already be flagged by it, but is worth a pass pointing it at ticfac the same way.
